main_measure.name: mean short-signed next-day return minus the coin's mean daily return

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases pooled by day

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of next-day return on run depth

decided_by: Mean short-signed excess return > 0 with t = 2.80 >= 2, negative depth slope, and 598 >= 30 cases.
reading: Profile and regime taken from the recorded regime (mean_reversion only arises inside the falling calm profile, whose 365-day percentile cannot be rebuilt from the record), depth from the depth component's last_history_value, cases are mean_reversion bars with nonzero forecast and a next-day close in the same window, the slope uses the raw next-day return with its ordinary OLS t, and the main t clusters cases by UTC day.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
